title: Detailed cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M26 40 L30 78 Q31 84 50 84 Q69 84 70 78 L74 40 Z' fill='#fafafa'/>

  <path d='M74 46 Q88 46 88 58 Q88 70 74 68' fill='none' stroke='#fafafa' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 46 Q85 47 85 58 Q85 69 74 68' fill='none' stroke='#e0e0e0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M49 14 Q52 10 50 6' fill='none' stroke='#dce8f4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59 18 Q62 14 60 10' fill='none' stroke='#dce8f4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cup front highlight -->
  <path d='M34 48 Q34 44 40 43' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1' fill='#6b3f1a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='43.5' r='1' fill='#6b3f1a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41.5' r='0.9' fill='#6b3f1a'/>
